ai_summary: Executive Summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) successfully concluded its 62nd Annual General Meeting, passing all seven resolutions, and adopting the FY2026 financial statements which received unqualified audit opinions and no C&AG comments. However, a material 23.44% of votes from Public-Institutions were cast against the adoption of financial statements, indicating significant institutional dissent despite the clean audit reports. Furthermore, participation from Public-Non Institutions in the voting for this crucial resolution was notably low at just 0.43%.
